channel.title: CVE Daily — AI Curated
channel.description: Today's vulnerability landscape is dominated by widespread remote code execution and command injection flaws across web applications, cloud infrastructure, and network equipment, with significant impacts on IoT routers, enterprise networking gear, and major cloud platforms. Authentication and authorization bypasses remain prevalent, affecting critical systems like Kubernetes clusters, virtualization managers, and database middleware, while deserialization and buffer overflow vulnerabilities continue to enable memory corruption and privilege escalation across desktop and industrial control environments. Notable targets include consumer routers from D-Link and Tenda, enterprise solutions from Red Hat and Juniper, and widely used web frameworks, underscoring a broad attack surface spanning automated deployment pipelines, AI model workflows, and traditional IT infrastructure.
